# statements before an explicit constructor invocation

class Base {
  Base(int value) {}
}

class Child extends Base {
  Child(int value) {
    int adjusted = value + 1;
    super(adjusted);
    consume(adjusted);
  }
}

==>

Program(
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    ClassBody(
      ConstructorDeclaration(
        Definition,
        FormalParameters(
          FormalParameter(
            PrimitiveType,
            Definition)),
        ConstructorBody))),
  ClassDeclaration(
    class,
    Definition,
    Superclass(extends, TypeName),
    ClassBody(
      ConstructorDeclaration(
        Definition,
        FormalParameters(
          FormalParameter(
            PrimitiveType,
            Definition)),
        ConstructorBody(
          LocalVariableDeclaration(
            PrimitiveType,
            VariableDeclarator(
              Definition,
              AssignOp,
              BinaryExpression(
                Identifier,
                ArithOp,
                IntegerLiteral))),
          ExplicitConstructorInvocation(
            super,
            ArgumentList(Identifier)),
          ExpressionStatement(
            MethodInvocation(
              MethodName(Identifier),
              ArgumentList(Identifier))))))))
